correctness.rationale: The proof constructs, for every integer \(n\ge2\), an Eulerian universal cycle for cyclic Golden-Mean \(n\)-words, parses it by the prefix code \(0\mapsto0\) and \(1\mapsto10\), proves the parsed word primitive, counts exactly \(F_{n+1}\) codeword boundaries, and bounds every distinct orbit pair by weighted common-prefix length at most \(n-1\). The source coding lemma converts this symbolic gap to Euclidean gap by the positive first-level separation. The identity \(\rho^s=\varphi^{-1}\) then gives the positive explicit lower limit \(\delta_{\mathcal F}^s\varphi^2/\sqrt5\). No finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.
